label: layer cleaning
purpose: Per-sample weighting cartridge for Layer 0/1 cleaning. Renders a per-sample bar showing final weight ∈ [0, 1]. Kinship + family-size downweighting + hatchery-duplicate exclusion so close relatives don't double-count in deep-Layer-2 stats.
input_contract: atlasState.inversion.layer_cleaning_state = { n_samples, kinship?: Float64Array (n × n), family_ids?: Array<*>, hatchery_dup?: boolean[], sample_labels?, candidate_label? }
